title: Broncos will explore bringing in TE Taysom Hill

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos will explore bringing in TE Taysom Hill
sources.description: Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton told NFL Network’s Cynthia Frelund that they will explore bringing in former New Orleans Saints veteran tight end/quarterback/running back Taysom Hill. Hill flourished under Sean Payton with the Saints and had teams scrambling to find the next Taysom Hill every year since. Now, the soon-to-be 36-year-old tight end who […]
